title: Strongly converging unitary representations for extensions by exact groups
summary: We prove the existence of strongly converging unitary representations in various new settings of countable groups, in particular, arising as extensions by exact groups: semidirect products with amenable groups; generalized wreath products with abelian base; graph wreath products; various free-by-cyclic groups including Gersten's group; and general Bernoulli shift crossed products on $C^*$-algebras.
